lsc-baseline-trainer.description: Trains the legacy Bi-GRU on the new rotation+handedness-invariant landmark data for fair head-to-head comparison with the SignTransformer.

lsc-android-integrator.description: Replaces the Android DynamicSignClassifier (Bi-GRU) with the new SignTransformer ONNX export. Integrates CentroidClassifier, AdaptiveThresholds, calibration flow, and live confidence UI.

lsc-llm-postprocessor.description: Adds Phi-3-mini INT4 as an on-device post-processor (NOT a classifier replacement) for natural-language sentence rephrasing. Compares llama.cpp Android vs MLC LLM vs ONNX Runtime GenAI.

lsc-user-validator.description: Authors the F7 test protocol, builds the Android data-collection helper, and analyzes 5-user real-world test results. Produces docs/F7_USER_TEST_REPORT.md with per-user/per-sign accuracy, confusion matrix, and latency.

lsc-pipeline-engineer.description: Wraps the LSC pipeline (extract, augment, train, evaluate, export) in a single reproducible full_pipeline.sh/bat command. Adds smoke tests for augmentations, normalization, SignTransformer forward pass, and an end-to-end slow test.
